description: Create or update a saved reply snippet (up to 50 per workspace) for the Unified Inbox (Studio and Pro). Use {name} to insert the author’s first name automatically.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

category.description: Where this saved reply applies: "all" (default), "comment", or "review".

id.description: An existing saved reply id from inbox_replies_list to update. Leave out to create a new saved reply (up to 50 per workspace).

shortcut.description: Optional shortcut key (1 to 30 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores), such as "thanks" or "hours".

text.description: Saved reply text (1 to 2000 characters). Include {name} to insert the author’s first name automatically.

title.description: Short label for the saved reply (1 to 60 characters), such as "5-star thank you" or "Hours and booking".

name: inbox_replies_save
title: Save an inbox reply snippet
